title: Apple overhauls App Store fees in the EU with new unified terms - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple is also announcing new terms for App Store commission rates, alternative app payments, and apps distributed through alternative marketplaces or the web. They added that the Commission will monitor Apple’s implementation of the new terms.
